title: Vision dense-document reliability
goal: Measure dense document extraction and evidence-grounded summarization.
prompt: Use vision.analyze with mode document, detail high, and output detailed. Extract owner, risk, deadline, decision, findings, and next review. Mark unreadable fields instead of guessing.
prerequisites: Configure and explicitly enable a vision-capable live route.
steps: Run the document prompt against the deterministic review fixture.
Compare the core fields and decision with manifest.json.
Check that findings remain grounded in the document.
assertions: Owner, risk, deadline, and decision are exact.
No absent customer, financial, or approval facts are invented.
Dense output remains readable and identifies uncertainty when present.
notes: Accuracy percent uses the five expected manifest items; score additional findings separately in observations.
